findings.finding: The 12-month de-SPAC lock-up on sponsor and Legacy Kodiak consideration shares expired 2026-09-24, and affiliate selling is documented as ongoing (Wendel 3.25M shares 09-25, 164,707 on 09-29, 760 on 09-30), so newly free legacy supply keeps landing in the 2026-10-02 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The supply is already unlocked and being sold daily: each of the last four sessions after the expiry printed a large down day; nothing dates its end, so the 10-02 session trades with the same overhang. Further Form 144s from affiliates would be filed same-day as sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline own falls inside this post-expiry cascade: 09-18 -14.4% then -0.3%; 09-25 -12.6% (the Wendel 3.25M sale day) then -6.58%; 09-30 -9.9% then -12.76% (today). Earlier, non-supply falls (2025-10, 2025-11, 2026-05) bounced +3 to +15%.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has absorbed a week of selling but not the remaining unlocked inventory: the Form 144s show only one affiliate, and non-affiliate legacy holders and the sponsor file nothing when they sell, so the size still to come is invisible. If the supply were spent, today's fall would have come on exhausted volume; it came on 3.1x normal volume with no news catalyst, and a positive AWS release this morning failed to hold the price.
findings.independence: Form 144s (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853138/000196858226001014/xsl144X01/primary_doc.xml , https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853138/000195917326007143/xsl144X01/primary_doc.xml) independently show unlocked founder shares being sold starting the day after expiry; secondary commentary notes 'each rally in KDK is being sold into' (https://www.timothysykes.com/news/kodiak-ai-inc-kdk-news-2026_09_30/).

findings.finding: Short interest stood at 10.04M shares (7.7 days to cover) at the 2026-09-15 settlement, up 12.4%, so a cover-driven bounce in the 2026-10-02 session is possible.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Shorts sitting on a -45% 20-day gain can cover into the next session; this is a standing state rather than a dated event, so it is weighted small.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed squeeze in this cascade: the post-drop sessions on 09-19, 09-26 and 10-01 were -0.3%, -6.6% and -12.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: The settlement predates the lock-up expiry; part of the short is likely lock-up hedging that is closed by delivering released shares rather than by buying, which is why it is small.
